    visited = set()
    components = []

        comp = [(start_r, start_c)]
        queue = [(start_r, start_c)]
        while queue:
            r, c = queue.pop(0)
            for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:

    return components
